t: 2030 — First system hulls systems operational: surge wards detection ne
title: 2030 — First system hulls systems operational: surge wards detection ne
definition: 2030 milestone on the Hospital Surge Systems roadmap.
description:
First system hulls systems operational: surge wards detection networks live on every continent.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed surge wards demonstrations, system logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting staff pools uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Hospital Surge Systems
definition: Estimates Hospital Surge Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Hospital Surge Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Hospital Surge Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Hospital Surge Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Hospital Surge Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 76572 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where surge wards monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or staff pools maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Hospital Surge Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Hospital Surge Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Hospital Surge Systems — systems expanding hospitals in crises.

Phase 1 — Prove (surge wards): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (staff pools): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (supply caches): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and healthcare-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
